find.title: Find a meetup
lines: The home page is the game lobby — filter open meetups by city and day of the week.
Each card shows the meetup's intro, time and how many have joined — pick one and tap in.

join.title: Join this session
lines: Got a password (from the host)? → Just enter it to go straight in.
No password? For meetups open to sign-ups you can register in one tap, leave a note, and even '+Bring family' to sign up together — you're in automatically once the host approves.

queue.title: Queue to play
lines: Once inside, pick a court and 'Go on court' or 'Queue' — you can only hold one court at a time, so it's fair with no spot-grabbing.
You'll get a notification when it's your turn, so you won't miss it even if you step away.

rotate.title: Rotate after each game
lines: The game starts automatically once 4 players are on court; when 2 of them vote to end, it wraps up and the next group is up.
Games played and minutes are tracked automatically; when the host turns on 'Fair Play', anyone who's played a lot yields to those who've played less.
